title: PEPPOL FR improvements
summary: French PEPPOL exports now correctly handle billing profiles, identifiers, regulatory comments, and delivery information to meet partner feedback and French e-invoicing requirements.
key_points: Corrected French and Extended CTC France customization identifiers and billing profile selection
Added Extended CTC line order references, shipment identifiers, and delivery dates for multi-order invoices
Updated supplier and buyer SIREN/SIRET identification with preserved electronic-address schemes
Added billing references for credit memos and removed zero-value allowance totals from generated XML
Grouped regulatory comments by type to produce single UBL notes without repetition
quote: French PEPPOL exports need to meet partner feedback and French e-invoicing requirements for identifiers, billing profiles, regulatory comments, document references, and participant routing.
